policies.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina ordinary passport: citizenship
policies.summary: A traveller using an ordinary Bosnia and Herzegovina passport is classified as a BiH citizen, not as a foreign visitor under the visa regime.
conditions: The Border Police says that a BiH citizen who holds another citizenship is not considered a foreigner in the territory of BiH.
This classification does not establish entry treatment for a dual national presenting another state's passport, nor work, residence, transit or final border-control treatment.

policies.title: Bahrain, Oman and Saudi Arabia ordinary passports: temporary visa-free entry through 30 September 2026
policies.summary: Official Gazette 37/26 exempts ordinary passport holders of Bahrain, Oman and Saudi Arabia from a visa for entry, exit, transit and stay from 1 June through 30 September 2026.
conditions: The waiver is limited to holders of ordinary passports of Bahrain, Oman and Saudi Arabia.
Within the stated temporary period, the aggregate stay permitted is no more than 60 days.
This policy does not establish a rule after 30 September 2026, work, residence, special-passport, document, security or final border-admission treatment.
